record.question: Who is the Education Minister of Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer B: Pu Lalsawta. Lalsawta was Education Minister in the administration relevant to the March 2010 paper. The Thirteenth Finance Commission's contemporaneous Mizoram visit record lists Shri Lalsawta as Minister, Education; a September 2010 Assembly record also identifies him as the higher/technical education minister. Historical/source note: Historical 2010 officeholder, not a present-day minister. Reference: https://fincomindia.nic.in/asset/pdf/commission-reports/13fcreng.pdf; https://mizoramassembly.in/storage/Assembly/Proceedings/State/Sixth_Assembly/6th_Session/Mizo/2010/mi_pro21092010.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
